<\STATESEP>section "Additional Syntax for Word Bit Operations"<\STATESEP>0<\TRANSEP><\STATESEP>theory Word_Syntax
imports
  "HOL-Library.Word"
begin<\STATESEP>0<\TRANSEP><\STATESEP>context
  includes bit_operations_syntax
begin<\STATESEP>0<\TRANSEP><\STATESEP>abbreviation
  wordNOT  :: "'a::len word \<Rightarrow> 'a word"      ("~~ _" [70] 71)
where
  "~~ x == NOT x"<\STATESEP>0<\TRANSEP><\STATESEP>abbreviation
  wordAND  :: "'a::len word \<Rightarrow> 'a word \<Rightarrow> 'a word" (infixr "&&" 64)
where
  "a && b == a AND b"<\STATESEP>0<\TRANSEP><\STATESEP>abbreviation
  wordOR   :: "'a::len word \<Rightarrow> 'a word \<Rightarrow> 'a word" (infixr "||"  59)
where
  "a || b == a OR b"<\STATESEP>0<\TRANSEP><\STATESEP>abbreviation
  wordXOR  :: "'a::len word \<Rightarrow> 'a word \<Rightarrow> 'a word" (infixr "xor" 59)
where
  "a xor b == a XOR b"<\STATESEP>0<\TRANSEP><\STATESEP>end<\STATESEP>0<\TRANSEP><\STATESEP>end<\STATESEP>0<\TRANSEP>
